description: Recent records from a common San Francisco open dataset (data.sfgov.org, also written data.sf.gov) by friendly name — no Socrata id needed. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "recent crime/police incidents in San Francisco", "SF 311 complaints", "SF building permits / evictions / business registrations", "SF restaurant inspection scores", "SFO passenger traffic", "SF purchasing / procurement / vendor spending / commodity codes". Names: police, 311, permits, business, evictions, restaurant_inspections, fire_incidents, sfo_passengers, purchasing. Returns the latest rows (sorted newest-first). Add a SoQL `where` to filter; for anything else use sf_query.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.

dataset.description: One of: police, 311, permits, business, evictions, restaurant_inspections, fire_incidents, sfo_passengers, purchasing.

where.description: Optional SoQL filter, e.g. "incident_category='Larceny Theft'" or "supervisor_district=6". Omit for all recent rows.

name: sf_recent
